public.title: Drop While
public.description: The predicate descriptor is {kind,value}, where kind is "gt", "eq", or "even". For gt compare numeric elements strictly to value, for eq compare scalar elements strictly, and for even accept even integers (value is ignored). The array contains at most 50 integers from -1000 through 1000; eq may also use scalar values. This descriptor stands for a callback; arbitrary source functions and sparse arrays are outside this adapter. Drop the longest matching prefix and return the remaining suffix; stop at the first nonmatching element when scanning from the left. Supported inputs are dense JSON values only: at most 100 total nodes, nesting depth at most 6, each string at most 80 UTF-16 code units, and integers from -1000 through 1000 unless narrower bounds are given. Unless the adapter explicitly defines path keys or another key format, object keys are nonempty ASCII letters without dots. All keys exclude prototype-related names. Inputs are valid; no validation is requested. Array order matters, object key order does not. Return a JSON value; no browser or third-party library is available. The complete serialized argument array is limited to 2048 UTF-8 bytes, counting JSON escaping. These whole-input limits also apply to descriptors, operations and nested values.
